Privacy Policy

How AtriBotix collects, uses and protects your information.

Last updated: 31 October 2026

1. Who we are

This website is operated by AtriBotix, Bistauli Bujurg, Belipar, Gorakhpur, UP-273413. AtriBotix provides robotics, AI, IoT, coding, drone and 3D printing education and runs the AtriBotix Student Innovation Program (ASIP). This policy explains what personal information the website collects and how it is used.

2. Information we collect

Information you give us

  • Contact form: your name, email address, mobile number and message.
  • Career form: your name, email address, mobile number and the resume file you upload (PDF, DOC or DOCX).
  • WhatsApp: the Buy Now, Contact and Apply buttons open a chat in WhatsApp. What you write there is handled by WhatsApp under its own terms and privacy policy.

Information collected automatically

  • Server logs: like most websites, our hosting provider may record technical data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested.
  • Your cookie choice: saved in your browser so we do not ask you again.
  • Analytics (only with your consent): if you accept analytics cookies, we may use Google Analytics 4 to count visits and button clicks.

3. How we use your information

  • To reply to your enquiry and give you the details you asked for.
  • To review job applications and contact applicants.
  • To keep the website secure and prevent spam or abuse.
  • To understand how the website is used and improve it (analytics, only if you consent).

4. Cookies and similar technologies

Essential storage is needed for the forms and security features to work. Analytics cookies are optional and are not loaded until you accept them. You can change your choice at any time with the Cookie Settings link in the website footer.

5. Third-party services

  • Google Fonts: fonts are loaded from Google, so your browser contacts Google servers when a page opens.
  • Google Analytics: only if you accept analytics cookies.
  • WhatsApp: only if you choose to open a chat.
  • Email delivery: form messages are sent to our email inbox by the website server.

6. Storage, security and sharing

Form submissions and uploaded resumes are stored on our server in a location that is not publicly accessible. We use security measures such as HTTPS, spam protection and input checks, but no system is completely secure. This website does not take online payments and does not collect card or bank details. We do not sell or rent the information you submit through this website.

7. How long we keep information

We keep enquiries and applications only for as long as needed for the purpose they were sent for, or as required by law. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

8. Your choices and rights

You may ask us to show you the personal information we hold about you, correct it, delete it, or stop using it for a purpose you previously agreed to (for example analytics). Contact us using the details below and we will respond as required by applicable law in India.

9. Children

This website is intended for parents, guardians, schools and adults. If you are under 18, please ask a parent or guardian to contact us for you.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
